This Nordic-inspired glass wall sconce combines vintage charm with modern craftsmanship. Its rippled glass disc diffuses a warm, radiant light that beautifully enhances any interior — perfect for bedrooms, hallways, or living rooms.

Why You’ll Love It

Art Deco Elegance – Striped glass design reflects light with subtle sophistication.


Warm Ambient Lighting – Creates a soft, inviting glow that enhances any room.


Premium Materials – Made with thick glass and a sturdy metal base for durability.


Versatile Colours – Available in Cognac, Smoke Grey, and Frosted White.


Compact Statement Piece – Adds luxury without overpowering your décor.

Material: Glass
Dimensions: Width 9.45" (24 cm), Depth 7.87" (20 cm)

Australian homes that blend classic and modern elements — ideal for bedside lighting, hallways, or as a pair in elegant living rooms.

Warm Glow, Vintage Soul

Add a touch of retro sophistication to your home with the Mireta Glass Pendant Light.
Its beautifully tinted glass shade blends nostalgic charm with modern simplicity, casting a soft, golden light that warms any space. Whether suspended above a dining table, bar, or hallway, Mireta creates a statement that feels both stylish and timeless.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Retro-Inspired Design – Elegant ridged glass brings a touch of vintage charm.

 

  • Warm Ambient Light – Creates a welcoming glow ideal for dining or living areas.

 

  • Premium Craftsmanship – Hand-blown tinted glass with refined metal detailing.

 

  • Versatile Style – Complements modern, retro, or eclectic interiors.

 

  • Easy Installation – Standard ceiling mount with adjustable cable height.

Specifications

Material: Glass + Metal
Light Source: LED (bulb included or optional)
Voltage: AC 220–230V (AU compatible)
Size: Ø28 × H16 cm
Lighting Area: 5–10 m²
Colour Options: Amber / Olive Green
Style: Retro / Modern / Artistic
Mount Type: Ceiling mount
Dimmable: No

 

Australian homes seeking warm, nostalgic charm — ideal above dining tables, kitchen bars, or reading nooks where atmosphere matters most.

products.body_html:
Soft Glow, Timeless Form

Elevate your space with the White Glass Pendant Light, a refined blend of mid-century style and modern minimalism. Its smooth, milky-white glass shade diffuses a soft, ambient glow that enhances dining rooms, kitchens, or living spaces with effortless sophistication.

Why You’ll Love It

Mid-Century Elegance – Classic dome and tiered forms for a timeless aesthetic.

Warm Diffused Light – Milky glass softens the light for a calm, inviting atmosphere.

Premium Materials – Brass accents complement the hand-blown white glass shade.

Versatile Design – Available in three shapes to suit your layout and taste.

Adjustable Height – 1.5 m cord allows flexible hanging options for any ceiling.

Specifications

Material: Glass + Brass
Light Source: E27 bulb (not included)
Voltage: 110–120 V
Cord Length: 1.5 m (adjustable)
Available Styles:
A – Ø30 cm × H13 cm
B – Ø28 cm × H19 cm
C – Ø32 cm × H14 cm
Mounting Type: Pendant / Ceiling Mount
Style: Mid-Century / Modern / Minimalist

Australian interiors that value calm, balanced design — ideal for dining rooms, kitchens, or cafes where soft, ambient lighting completes the mood.
